stem:
The diagram shows Ishaan’s cold steel bottle left in warm, moist air. Tiny liquid water droplets form on the outside of the bottle.

Which description of the change is correct?

options.text: Water vapour cooled and condensed: gas changed into liquid water on the bottle.
Ice changed from solid to liquid by evaporation.
The droplets would form even if the bottle were hotter than the air, only because air is moist.
Heating the moist air makes water freeze into ice on the bottle.

teacher.key_rationale: Condensation is gas to liquid on cooling. Evaporation is liquid to gas; cooling of the surface matters; heating does not freeze water onto the bottle.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source force diagram into cold bottle with moist-air arrows and condensation droplets.
